name: Barbarian
summary: A fierce warrior who fights in a primal rage.
description: Barbarians channel a primal rage that makes them hard to kill and devastating in melee.

name: Bard
summary: An inspiring performer whose magic is woven from words and music.
description: Bards use music, story, and magic to inspire allies, undermine foes, and cast spells.

name: Cleric
summary: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.
description: Clerics are intermediaries between the mortal world and the distant planes of the gods, and draw on divine magic to heal and to smite.

name: Druid
summary: A wielder of nature's magic who can shift into animal forms.
description: Druids draw on the power of nature to cast spells and to take the shape of beasts.

name: Fighter
summary: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.
description: Fighters are skilled with every weapon and every form of armor, and have the broadest training in combat.

properties.armor_training: Light armor, Medium armor, Heavy armor, Shields

name: Monk
summary: A martial artist who channels ki into swift unarmed strikes.
description: Monks fight with unarmed strikes and a pool of ki, moving with speed and precision rather than armor.

name: Paladin
summary: A holy warrior bound by a sacred oath.
description: Paladins combine martial skill with divine magic, empowered by an oath they have sworn.

properties.armor_training: Light armor, Medium armor, Heavy armor, Shields

name: Ranger
summary: A hunter and scout who uses martial skill and nature magic.
description: Rangers track, hunt, and survive in the wild, supported by primal magic.

name: Rogue
summary: A stealthy expert who strikes where the enemy is weak.
description: Rogues rely on skill, stealth, and precise strikes, and are masters of finding and exploiting weakness.

name: Sorcerer
summary: A spellcaster whose magic is innate, born of bloodline or fate.
description: Sorcerers hold magic in their blood and can bend their spells with sorcery points.

name: Warlock
summary: A seeker of power who bargains with an otherworldly patron.
description: Warlocks gain magic from a pact with a powerful being, casting a few potent spells that recover on a short rest.

name: Wizard
summary: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.
description: Wizards are supreme magic-users, defined as a class by the spells they cast, which they study and record in a spellbook.
